Interface IFundamentalFeedConnector

All Known Implementing Classes:
EulerpoolFeedConnector, FinnhubConnector, YahooFundamentalConnector
public interface IFundamentalFeedConnector
A source of fundamental base values of direct equities, asked once a week by the task FUNDAMENTAL_DATA_LOAD. Finnhub and Eulerpool implement it in their price connectors, because only those can read their API key; Yahoo has a connector of its own.
